code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Solid horizontal bands: complete the reflected row pattern.
    if all(len(set(row)) <= 1 for row in grid):
        out = [row[:] for row in grid]
        for r in range(h):
            if all(v == 0 for v in out[r]):
                out[r] = out[h - 1 - r][:]
        return out
    # The diagonal clue lines encode a repeating pattern by c-r residue.
    cells = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v]
    for p in range(1, max(h, w) + 1):
        vals = {}
        ok = True
        for r, c, v in cells:
            k = (c - r) % p
            if k in vals and vals[k] != v:
                ok = False
                break
            vals[k] = v
        if ok and len(vals) == p:
            return [[vals[(c-r) % p] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    raise ValueError('Could not infer complete diagonal period')
'''
